frame-arabic.note: No Arabic in any of the 20 frames.

frame-hidden.note: No recordings: every frame is drawn by the kit.

frame-google.note: Google appears only as plain words (Approved line, Published line, end card line, small print); no Google logo or colours.

frame-proof.note: The only review shown is the Example business (Juniper Hair Studio) demo text: no stars, no count, no logo, and it is not shown as a Kabsi testimonial.

frame-people.note: No people or faces in any frame; the mark is the only picture.

frame-example.note: The Example badge is in the chat header on every chat frame from 0.0 to 6.5 s, as long as the Example business is on screen.

frame-yes.note: The Yes, Edit, Skip buttons show from 0.5 s, the Yes is tapped at 4.5 s and the owner's Yes bubble follows.

safe-zone.note: All text is inside the safe area on the contact sheet (re-checked after the copy change: the Approved line is two lines, the Undo button reads Undo).

captions-clear.note: Captions sit on plain paper below the chat, about 46 px under the last bubble, never over a button, bubble or the tap.

tap-rings.note: One soft dark ring over the Yes button at 4.5 s, visible on the button.

end-card.note: From 7.5 s: the real mark with the Kabsi wordmark, the line, the call to action and the small print, until the end.

hook.note: The review with its Yes, Edit, Skip buttons and the caption "A new review came in." are on screen by 0.5 s.

sound-off.note: Captions carry every spoken line and the chat shows the story: review, Yes, Approved, Published.
